title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: We've seen a number of latent prompt regressions make it into main where a model or prompt tweak causes a per-prompt quality drop that is only caught in production. This PR adds a CI hook that runs the eval-harness per-prompt metrics and fails the PR when regression thresholds are exceeded. Motivation: give engineering teams a fast, automated safety net for prompt/behavior regressions and integrate results with our metrics pipeline so failures are auditable and actionable. What changed: - New CI hook script: ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py that runs a targeted subset of eval prompts for the changed package(s), uploads metrics to the eval-metrics service, and evaluates per-prompt deltas against configured thresholds. - Metrics client: eval-harness/metrics/client.py (lightweight wrapper to push results to the eval-metrics ingestion endpoint). - CI workflow: .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml updated to call the hook as an optional check on feature branches and as a gating check on protected branches. - Threshold config: eval-harness/ci/prompt_gates.yaml with defaults and per-team overrides. - Tests: tests/ci/test_prompt_gates.py adds unit tests and a small integration test with a mocked metrics backend. - Docs: docs/eval/ci.md documents how the hook works and how to configure thresholds and exemptions. Operational notes: - Default behavior is non-blocking for external contributors (bot leaves a comment) and blocking for internal branches; this is controlled by a config flag and can be tuned when we collect more signal. - Failures include detailed per-prompt diffs and links to the historical metric series in the eval-metrics UI. Rollout plan: staged rollout — enable gating for a small set of core repos for two weeks, gather false-positive rates, then expand. Related: ENG-5123, SUP-3341. Checklist: - [x] Hook implementation - [x] Metrics client - [x] CI workflow integration - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Documentation - [x] Feature-flagged gating

review_comments: Benji Liu: Left a request for clarification on how thresholds are computed and how we avoid false positives for noisy prompts. Suggested adding a moving-average option and an override whitelist.
Aisha Patel: Responded that thresholds support absolute and relative (percent) deltas and that a 7-day moving average is used by default; added config options and unit tests to exercise both modes.
Ravi Kapoor: Asked for an e2e test that simulates a regression and verifies CI fail behavior. Added tests/ci/test_prompt_gates.py with a mocked eval run and a local metrics server.
María Gómez: Noted linting issues and an edge case where binary artifacts could be included; requested a guard in the hook to skip large file diffs. Fixed in e5a8b0c.
CI Bot: run-lint failed initially (flake8 errors). Author fixed style issues and re-ran. All checks passed on final run.
ci_checks_summary: CI: lint -> fail (fixed), unit-tests -> pass, integration-tests -> pass (mocked metrics), e2e -> pass (smoke), security-scan -> pass
release_notes: Adds a CI-level per-prompt regression hook that can block merges when configured thresholds are exceeded; configurable thresholds and per-team overrides. Backward compatible by default (non-blocking for external PRs).
